caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile design featuring a symmetrical pattern composed primarily of blue and pink colors on a beige background. The central motif is a large, stylized floral shape in dark blue with intricate petal and leaf details, occupying the middle of the composition. On either side of the central motif are two large oval shapes outlined in blue, filled with pink leaf and branch patterns, all set against a beige ground. The edges and corners of the textile are bordered with alternating sections of solid blue geometric motifs and pink bands containing repeating decorative elements, such as diamond and wave shapes. The overall composition is balanced and organized, with strong horizontal and vertical alignment of the ornamental elements.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
